headline: Making DRVN ready for real people.
summary: Follow the work from safer payments to a carefully observed invited beta. Every bar is backed by named checkpoints.
current: Local checks pass: 640 unit tests, 104 fresh migrations, 42 SQL guard suites, 34 recovery cases, a 32-case Chromium/WebKit follow-up and 18 repeated feature checks. CI findings in publishing, login initialization and listing navigation are corrected. Current candidate-wide results are attached to PR #2; hosted and remaining acceptance gates stay open.

workstreams.title: A safe place to test
workstreams.why: Test changes without touching real buyers, sellers, or payments.
workstreams.before: Testing currently relies on local services; hosted beta access has not been verified.
workstreams.after: A separate HTTPS environment with invited access, test-only payments, controlled email, and repeatable setup.
workstreams.next: Resolve hosted project capacity; keep all destructive fixtures on the isolated local stack.

checkpoints.label: Invited-beta scope confirmed
checkpoints.evidence: User confirmed invited buyers and sellers in this task.

checkpoints.label: Fail-closed test project allowlist
checkpoints.evidence: 15/15 tests passed. Only the explicit local DRVN endpoint or a reviewed hosted project can receive fixtures; hosted allowlist is currently empty.

checkpoints.label: Server-side invitation boundaries
checkpoints.evidence: Server checks plus eight local database scenarios cover invite matching, expiry, revocation, direct Auth and commerce bypass attempts, and existing obligations.

checkpoints.label: Isolated hosted services
checkpoints.evidence: User selected n89b-dot’s Org. Connector quote is $0/month on Free, but both active free project slots are occupied; no existing project was paused or upgraded.

workstreams.title: Payment updates that cannot disappear
workstreams.why: Keep refunds, disputes, and seller-account changes consistent even when a database write fails.
workstreams.before: Some provider updates can be acknowledged before their effects are safely recorded.
workstreams.after: Failed saves stay retryable; uncertain events create one tracked recovery case. Pending and later-failed refunds receive explicit handling.
workstreams.next: Verify the final replacement/Connect workflow in staging; reconcile ambiguous allocations and approve seller recredit operations.

checkpoints.label: Failure paths confirmed
checkpoints.evidence: Reviewed settlement, webhook route, admin replay and refund provider code.

checkpoints.label: Durable webhook and replay writes
checkpoints.evidence: Checked provider event persistence, completion markers and admin replay; independently reviewed.

checkpoints.label: Asynchronous refund lifecycle
checkpoints.evidence: Pending/unknown states, exact provider identity, per-refund journal and late-failure counter compensation implemented; 43 focused tests and 16 SQL lifecycle checks passed.

checkpoints.label: Failure and replay regression tests
checkpoints.evidence: 34 focused webhook durability and replay tests passed. Async refund verification is a separate checkpoint.

checkpoints.label: Shipping persistence and partial-write replay
checkpoints.evidence: Exact provider matching, terminal conflict checks and partial-write replay verified. Retained EasyPost events now use the audited admin replay path; 8 routing tests passed.

checkpoints.label: Independent integration review
checkpoints.evidence: Independent cross-review corrections complete; 468 unit tests, 10 Stripe API tests, 17 SQL suites, typecheck and schema parity passed.

checkpoints.label: Late-failure seller re-credit and workflow recovery
checkpoints.evidence: Explicit linked replacement, immutable seller proof, dedicated reversal target, atomic provider admission, repeated-failure chains and safe case closure implemented and SQL-tested. Seller recredit creation/ambiguous allocations and hosted Connect acceptance remain operator work.

checkpoints.label: Provider-specific dispute ordering journal
checkpoints.evidence: Private provider journal, atomic open/close, exact basket admission, partial-dispute recovery, lease fencing and real local crash/replay integration pass.

checkpoints.label: Postage purchase and carrier-refund recovery
checkpoints.evidence: Outbound/return purchases and carrier refunds retain exact provider identities. Bounded automatic void reconciliation, 15-family worker health, local SQL/operations and browser transaction flows pass. Hosted carrier behavior remains a separate acceptance gate.

checkpoints.label: Hosted provider proof
checkpoints.evidence: Requires isolated HTTPS Stripe staging.

workstreams.title: Seller transfers that survive a crash
workstreams.why: Prevent a restarted worker from paying a seller twice or repeating a reversal.
workstreams.before: A crash can leave Stripe ahead of local records, and stale retries may miss that earlier transfer.
workstreams.after: Each transfer has a saved identity and amount; retries find and reconcile prior provider effects before issuing anything new.
workstreams.next: Verify hosted Connect crash-window behavior once isolated staging is available.

checkpoints.label: Crash paths confirmed
checkpoints.evidence: Reviewed stale claim SQL, transfer lookup and reversal recovery paths.

checkpoints.label: Durable transfer identity and reconciliation
checkpoints.evidence: Saved immutable dispatch identity, exact provider lookup, live worker ownership checks, and durable recovery for changed orders.

checkpoints.label: Reversal recovery beyond idempotency window
checkpoints.evidence: Frozen reversal parameters, provider-history reconciliation and lease-fenced completion; eight SQL checks pass. Hosted provider crash-window proof remains separate.

checkpoints.label: Crash, concurrency and mismatch tests
checkpoints.evidence: 27 transfer worker tests and the full SQL guard passed, including live-lease checks, conflicting identities, atomic recovery alerts and alert deduplication.

checkpoints.label: Database and integration review
checkpoints.evidence: Independent review corrected legacy repair and provider lookup; final migrations, all SQL guards and generated schema parity passed from a fresh database.

checkpoints.label: Hosted transfer and reversal proof
checkpoints.evidence: Requires test Connect accounts and staged providers.

workstreams.title: A green build you can trust

workstreams.before: The current green browser run includes one test that passed only after a retry.
workstreams.after: Flaky, skipped-required, and missing checks block release; the known fixture race is corrected and jobs have time limits.
workstreams.next: Review PR #2 candidate checks and resolve private-repository branch-protection availability before release.

checkpoints.label: Two clean hosted candidate runs

checkpoints.evidence: Private-repository protection requires an account-tier change.

workstreams.title: An account export that is complete
workstreams.why: Let members obtain all approved data about their account without exposing someone else’s private information.
workstreams.before: Some data families are missing, some exports use broad field selections, and large exports can exceed request limits.
workstreams.after: Explicit safe fields, complete approved sections, and resumable large exports with a completeness record.
workstreams.next: Obtain retention policy and hosted archive acceptance; local export/purge regression checks pass.

checkpoints.label: Field and ownership inventory
checkpoints.evidence: Explicit versioned field inventory covers both sides of messages and offers, order records, refunds, shipments and private evidence; internal/provider fields excluded.

checkpoints.label: Export and retention decisions
checkpoints.evidence: Requires the responsible policy owner.

checkpoints.label: Safe complete export implementation
checkpoints.evidence: Bounded durable export worker, private manifest/parts, ownership-checked downloads, expiry and lease-fenced checkpoints implemented.

checkpoints.label: Large-export and cross-account tests
checkpoints.evidence: Local integration passed: 501-row paginated export, ownership checks, cross-account signed-link denial, contract upgrade, deletion expiry, purge retry and late-orphan sweep. Hosted archive/policy acceptance remains separate.

workstreams.title: Deletion with an honest outcome
workstreams.why: Remove eligible personal data while preserving only records that must be retained.
workstreams.before: Protected financial references can prevent final deletion, and historical originals still need reconciliation.
workstreams.after: Members and operators see exactly what was removed or retained, why, and what happens next; eligible old media is cleaned up.
workstreams.next: Approve retention/original-file removal and verify hosted deletion acceptance; local retryable cleanup checks pass.

checkpoints.label: Retention and hold decisions
checkpoints.evidence: No legal retention period has been assumed.

checkpoints.label: Explicit deletion and operator states
checkpoints.evidence: Financial holds, cleanup progress and operator-retained-identity outcomes are explicit; existing job types and stale-session protections preserved.

checkpoints.label: Historical media normalization and cleanup
checkpoints.evidence: Historical inventory/normalization tooling and local media tests exist. Hosted inventory, retention approval and original/CDN removal remain outstanding.

checkpoints.label: Interrupted deletion and retained-record tests
checkpoints.evidence: SQL verifies explicit hold/operator outcomes and repeated deletion; actual local operations complete deletion after export and verify failed purge replay/newer-package isolation. Earlier isolated 160-object cleanup drill also passed.

workstreams.title: Problems reach a real operator
workstreams.why: Detect broken jobs and delivery failures quickly, with someone responsible for recovery.
workstreams.before: Local contracts exist, but real external notification and hosted recovery evidence is missing.
workstreams.after: Working email, independent outage alerts, observed schedules, and a practiced admin recovery process.
workstreams.next: Connect controlled email and monitoring in isolated staging.

checkpoints.label: External delivery and monitoring

checkpoints.evidence: Complete worker inventory, failed-run detection and overdue queue health implemented; privacy exports share tracked deletion cadence.

checkpoints.label: Hosted admin recovery rehearsal
checkpoints.evidence: Independent failure/recovery/escalation watcher with durable notification identity and dead-man heartbeat implemented. External delivery proof pending.
